scope: Author-produced dataset-level aggregates, all paired statistical tests, and an analysis plan summarized without per-image identifiers. No dataset images, annotations or individual OCR transcriptions are included.

files.transformation: Removed the original checkout prefix from provenance paths and replaced all image/OCR filename lists with seed-level counts. Family definitions, analysis settings and result values are unchanged.

metric_boundary: English *_f1 fields retain the paper word-matching rule; *_strict_f1 fields use exact-word scoring. Non-Latin unicode_f1 uses grapheme scoring. Results are copied from recorded measurements without inferred missing values.
